Seniors living far from primary care by area in 2031
sql: SELECT planning_area, cluster, ROUND(gap) AS seniors_far FROM workspace.healthpulse_gold.service_area_year WHERE service = 'primary' AND year = 2031 AND scenario_id = 'base|no_hsg' ORDER BY seniors_far DESC LIMIT 10

question: Day care places gap in Bedok from 2026 to 2031
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(need) AS places_needed, ROUND(capacity) AS places_reachable, ROUND(gap) AS places_gap FROM workspace.healthpulse_gold.service_area_year WHERE service = 'day_care' AND planning_area = 'Bedok' AND scenario_id = 'base|no_hsg' ORDER BY year

question: Beds and places avoided in 2031 if prevention targets are met
sql: SELECT service_label, ROUND(avoided) AS avoided, unit FROM workspace.healthpulse_gold.prevention_impact

question: Singapore community hospital beds needed vs capacity by year, pessimistic scenario
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(need) AS beds_needed, ROUND(capacity) AS beds_capacity, ROUND(area_gap_sum) AS sum_of_area_shortfalls, ROUND(national_gap) AS net_singapore_gap FROM workspace.healthpulse_gold.service_national_year WHERE service = 'community_hospital' AND scenario_id = 'pessimistic|no_hsg' ORDER BY year

question: Top 5 areas for nursing homes in 2031 with next steps
sql: SELECT rank, planning_area, cluster, ROUND(gap_2026) AS gap_now_beds, ROUND(gap_2031) AS gap_2031_beds, gap_start AS short_from_year, next_step, next_step_reason FROM workspace.healthpulse_gold.service_priorities WHERE service = 'nursing_home' AND scenario_id = 'base|no_hsg' AND rank <= 5 ORDER BY rank

content: This space answers where Singapore should prioritise community care for seniors, by planning area, 2026-2031. Services: community_hospital (beds), nursing_home (beds), day_care (day places), primary (coverage: seniors 65+ living more than 1 km from a polyclinic or CHAS GP).
Never add numbers across services: each service has its own unit (see column unit).

Default scenario: scenario_id = 'base|no_hsg'. Presets: optimistic (slower ageing, undated projects open), base, pessimistic (faster ageing, projects 2 years late). Suffix |hsg = prevention targets met (illustrative 10% lower use, not an official target). Say which scenario you used.

Two gap totals exist: area_gap_sum = sum of each area's shortfall (default, used in the App; a surplus in one area does not cancel a shortfall in another) and national_gap = net Singapore need minus capacity (smaller). Name the one you report. gap_start = first year an area is short (2026 = already short today). next_step is a cautious suggestion from the 2031 outlook ('Assess expansion' means verify nearby operating capacity first); cluster is approximated by the nearest polyclinic's cluster.

Gaps are estimates against today's Singapore-average level of care, not observed unmet need. 2026 is the baseline; 2027-2031 are forecasts. Nursing home and day care capacities are partly estimated; quote the confidence column when relevant.
